title: Lovely Uruguayan Almond Bake
description: A nutty and aerated Uruguayan dish featuring rose water, this wood-fired bake is a show-off dessert that is sugar-free friendly.
instructions: Preheat the wood-fired oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the almond flour, rose water, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, unsweetened almond milk, and melted coconut oil.
Add the vanilla extract to the wet ingredients and whisk until combined.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Pour the batter into a tagliere vessel.
Top the batter with sliced almonds.
Bake for 35 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Remove the bake from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
